label: Avatar / PFP
description: A profile picture: square, centred, and legible as a 32-pixel circle. The single most-generated artifact there is, and the one the crop rules decide.
prefix: A profile picture, square format, subject centred and cropped close
suffix: framed for an avatar: head and shoulders centred with even margins, a strong simple silhouette against a plain contrasting ground, still readable cropped to a small circle
negative: full body, busy background, off-centre crop, tiny detail, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage, nsfw
